name: K-16 Bryar Pistol
description: The K-16 Bryar Pistol was a model of Bryar pistol used by the soldiers of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire as well as criminals such as Khel Tanna and Akko. Deceptive by design, the K-16 appeared to be a regular blaster pistol; however, it featured a modified power unit capable of releasing its entire heat source in one powerful blast as secondary fire.
